name: Goofiez Live Cartridge 1g
description:
1g pure Rest Liquid Live Resin (LLR) cartridge crafted from premium fresh frozen flower. Compatible with all 510 thread batteries.
Rest products are derived from indica strains, which are associated with calm and relaxation. Our Rest offerings pair well with quality time, evening wind-downs and restorative self-care.
Goofiez​ is an indica-leaning strain bred from crossing Apples & Bananas, White Runtz, and Jet Fuel Gelato. Top terpenes β-Caryophyllene, Linalool, and Limonene produce minty and woody aromas with notes of pear. Get ready for potentially serious soothing, as this physically relaxing and mentally calming wave may wash over.
